Overview.Name: SABERA SHAIK
Overview.Goal: Improve energy, confidence, mental wellbeing, and support gradual fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 3: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + fish curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + mutton curry (small portion) + vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Chicken curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Fish pan fried + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Since sleep is less than 6 hours, keep dinners light to support digestion and recovery.
For sweet cravings, eat curd or a boiled egg first and wait 10 minutes.
Avoid frequent late-night eating as it affects energy and weight.
Use pressure cooked or pan fried methods to reduce oil.
Focus on daily routine and consistency rather than strict rules.
Yoga and regular meals will support both mental and physical wellbeing.
